newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real closes steady in calm trading.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real closes steady in calm trading.

text.p: Brazil's real currency ended steady at 1.0151 against the dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market in calm trading, dealers said.
"The market was calm as it normally is after a drop in the mini-band," one dealer said.
Last Friday, the Central Bank lowered the real-dollar mini-band to between 1.015 and 1.020 reais per dollar.
In late afternoon, the Central Bank bought dollars at 1.0150 reais per greenback. Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a Monday surplus of $35 million.

In the interbank forex floating rate market, the real rose 0.01 percent to close at 1.0200 to the dollar after the Central Bank sold dollars at 1.0200 reais per greenback during a morning auction. In the illegal parallel market, the real ended flat at 1.034 per dollar.
